title: New Class of Benzodiazepinone Derivatives as Pro-Death Agents Targeting BIR Domains in Cancer Cells.
authors: Fiore, Michele; Mosconi, Michele; Boni, Francesco; Parodi, Alice; Salis, Annalisa; Tasso, Bruno; Mastrangelo, Eloise; Millo, Enrico; Cossu, Federica
one_liner_zh: 该文研究苯二氮卓酮衍生物靶向IAP蛋白BIR结构域的抗癌活性，属于小分子-蛋白质互作，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作或TF-DNA体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Inhibitor of Apoptosis Proteins (IAPs) are validated targets for cancer therapy, and the deregulation of their activities within the NF-kappaB pathway correlates with chemoresistance events, even after treatment with IAPs-antagonists in the clinic (Smac-mimetics). The molecule FC2 was identified as a NF-kappaB pathway modulator in MDA-MB-231 adenocarcinoma cancer cells after virtual screening of the Chembridge library against the Baculoviral IAP Repeat 1 (BIR1) domain of cIAP2 and XIAP. An improved cytotoxic effect is observed when FC2 is combined with Smac-mimetics or with the cytokine Tumor Necrosis Factor (TNF). Here, we propose a library of 22 derivatives of FC2, whose scaffold was rationally modified starting from the position identified as R(1). The cytotoxic effect of FC2 derivatives was evaluated in MDA-MB-231 and binding to the cIAP2- and XIAP-BIR1 domains was assessed in fluorescence-based techniques and virtual docking. Among 22 derivatives, 4m and 4p display improved efficacy/potency in MDA-MB-231 cells and low micromolar binding affinity vs the target proteins. Two additional candidates (4b and 4u) display promising cytotoxic effects in combination with TNF, suggesting the connection between this class of molecules and the NF-kappaB pathway. These results provide the rationale for further FC2 modifications and the design of novel IAP-targeting candidates supporting known therapies.
abstract_zh: 凋亡抑制蛋白（IAPs）是癌症治疗的有效靶点，其在NF-kappaB通路中活性的失调与化疗耐药事件相关，即使在临床上使用IAPs拮抗剂（Smac-mimetics）治疗后也是如此。分子FC2是通过对Chembridge文库针对cIAP2和XIAP的杆状病毒IAP重复1（BIR1）结构域进行虚拟筛选后，在MDA-MB-231腺癌细胞中被鉴定为NF-kappaB通路调节剂。当FC2与Smac-mimetics或细胞因子肿瘤坏死因子（TNF）联合使用时，观察到细胞毒性效应增强。在此，我们提出一个包含22个FC2衍生物的文库，其骨架从被鉴定为R(1)的位置开始进行合理修饰。在MDA-MB-231细胞中评估了FC2衍生物的细胞毒性效应，并通过基于荧光的技术和虚拟对接评估了与cIAP2-和XIAP-BIR1结构域的结合。在22个衍生物中，4m和4p在MDA-MB-231细胞中显示出改善的功效/效力，并对靶蛋白具有低微摩尔级的结合亲和力。另外两个候选物（4b和4u）在与TNF联合使用时显示出有前景的细胞毒性效应，表明这类分子与NF-kappaB通路之间存在关联。这些结果为进一步的FC2修饰和设计支持已知疗法的新型IAP靶向候选物提供了依据。
